title: Auto Glass Services: Insurer Payment and Program Repricing
content:
Insurer relations clause of Crestline Collision & Glass on the insurer's side of an **Auto Glass Services** insurance glass claim job: the payment expected from the insurer's glass program and the treatment of a program repricing.

## Clause

> The insurer's glass program is expected to pay within the tier's insurer payment terms in days of billing. When the program reprices a billing to its own price list, the reduction is accepted as a program repricing adjustment when it is no more than the tier's dispute threshold percent of the billed amount; a larger reduction is disputed with the program and no adjustment is booked while the dispute is open. A repricing is never passed on to the customer.

## The insurer's balance

What the insurer owes on a glass claim job: billings increase it; insurer payments and price adjustments reduce it. A billing is original or corrected. An adjustment reduces a billing and is booked against that billing, either as a program repricing or as the correction of a billing error. Each remittance is recorded with its reference verbatim.

## Repricing decision

| Reduction by the program, as a share of the billed amount | Treatment |
|---|---|
| no more than the dispute threshold percent | accepted; a program repricing adjustment is booked |
| more than the dispute threshold percent | disputed with the program; no adjustment is booked while the dispute is open |

In either case the customer's charges are unaffected: a repricing is never passed on to the customer.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

A billing of 480.00 on a tier whose dispute threshold is, for this illustration, 5 percent; 5 percent of 480.00 is 24.00.

| Program reprices the billing to | Reduction | Share of billed amount | Treatment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 460.00 | 20.00 | about 4.2 percent | accepted as a program repricing adjustment of 20.00 |
| 456.00 | 24.00 | exactly 5 percent | accepted as a program repricing adjustment of 24.00 |
| 450.00 | 30.00 | 6.25 percent | disputed; nothing booked while the dispute is open |
